components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main save, submit, connect, or confirm action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.5625rem 1.125rem; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:var(--color-primary); color:var(--color-primary-foreground); font:600 .875rem/1.5 "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s,transform .15s,box-shadow .2s; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width:1rem; height:1rem; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-primary-hover); box-shadow:var(--shadow-glow); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A solid-tonal alternative for adjacent, non-destructive actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.5rem 1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius:8px; background:var(--color-surface-2); color:var(--color-on-surface); font:500 .875rem/1.5 "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s,border-color .2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--color-surface-3); border-color:var(--color-border-strong); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: A readable labeled field with tonal fill, semantic focus, and error support.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.375rem; } .ds-field-label { color:var(--color-on-surface-muted); font:700 .75rem/1.2 "DM Sans",sans-serif; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.5625rem .875rem; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--color-surface-2); color:var(--color-on-surface); font:400 .9375rem/1.5 "DM Sans",sans-serif; transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--color-on-surface-dim); } .ds-input:focus { outline:0; border-color:var(--color-primary); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--color-primary-muted); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color:var(--color-danger); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--color-danger-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
Laravel CRM is an instrument panel for agents, Team Leaders, and administrators who need to see the next actionable state without leaving the call workflow. The visual system is dark-first and telephony-aware: a quiet charcoal surface stack gives the magenta brand signal and semantic status colors room to communicate clearly during long operational sessions.

The density is compact but not cramped. Fixed navigation, a sticky header, short labels, compact cards and tables, and persistent floating call/form controls keep the workspace scannable while preserving room for lead data and form completion. Surfaces are calm at rest and gain lift only when they become interactive or layered. The public login is intentionally more expressive, using a glass sheet as an entry moment without turning the operational workspace into a decorative canvas.
keyCharacteristics: Magenta as a scarce action, focus, and active-state signal.
Semantic status colors for connection, outcome, attention, and error.
Compact, data-rich surfaces designed for repeated scanning.
Telephony widgets that remain available without obscuring the primary work.
Visible focus, generous touch targets, contained overflow, and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Use the primary accent to answer “what is active or actionable?” Keep it rare enough that a magenta edge, label, or control is immediately legible.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Prefer a change in surface tone before adding a border or shadow. Every layer should explain what is above or below it.

rules.name: The Case Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Uppercase and letter spacing belong to labels, navigation groups, table headers, and status metadata; headings and body copy remain in sentence case.

rules.name: The Layer-First Rule
rules.body: Add tonal separation before adding shadow. Shadows should describe a surface crossing a boundary, not decorate every component.

dos: Do use the frontmatter tokens and existing CSS custom properties as the source of truth.
Do keep magenta for action, selection, focus, active navigation, and meaningful emphasis.
Do pair semantic colors with text, icons, or structure so state is never color-only.
Do preserve the 44px interaction target and visible focus treatment on every interactive control.
Do keep telephony state, campaign scope, and the next call action visible in the working context.
Do contain table and notification overflow inside their own scroll regions.
Do honor the dark/light theme switch and prefers-reduced-motion: reduce behavior.
Do use lift and motion to clarify state changes, not to make static data feel busy.
donts: Don't turn the operational shell into a glassmorphism or gradient-heavy composition; reserve that atmosphere for the login threshold and explicitly branded entry surfaces.
Don't add a second brand accent or use semantic colors as decoration.
Don't nest arbitrary rounded cards inside rounded cards without a real grouping need.
Don't make static cards translate on hover or hide important actions behind hover-only behavior.
Don't rely on color alone for call, connection, validation, or notification state.
Don't shrink labels, fields, or icon controls below the established touch and readability floor to fit a dense layout.
Don't allow a wide report, widget, or notification detail to create page-level horizontal overflow.
Don't add motion that continues, pulses, or shimmers when the user has requested reduced motion.
